tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products by name or by category and spec filters; returns key specs and the best in-stock offer. Example: {"query":"0.4 hardened nozzle","category":"nozzle","limit":5}

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full specs with per-field confidence and source, every offer with verified time, 30/90-day price range. Example: {"product_id":"prusa-mk4s"}

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Side-by-side spec table with offers and the fields that differ. Pass 2-10 product_ids, or a category with filters. Example: {"product_ids":["e3d-v6-brass-0-4","bondtech-cht-0-4"]}

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Does this part fit that machine? Returns a verdict with the rule id and version that decided it, or the missing fields. Example: {"subject_id":"e3d-v6-brass-0-4","target_id":"prusa-mk4s"}

tools.name: check_stock
tools.description: Availability and price per merchant, re-verified live when the data is over an hour old. Example: {"product_id":"prusa-mk4s","merchant_id":"prusa3d"}

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Flag a wrong spec, price or fit verdict. Reports never edit facts; two independent reports mark a fact disputed. Example: {"entity_type":"product","entity_id":"prusa-mk4s","field":"nozzle_thread","claim":"MK4S uses the Nextruder thread"}
